items.title: SpaceX stock hits new all-time low as AI capex jumps in Q2
items.summary: SpaceX reported second quarter results on Tuesday that topped estimates — its first report as a public company — which comes as the stock has been in a recent free fall.

items.title: SpaceX And Tesla Earnings Have A Similar Theme: Capex Spending
items.summary: Elon Musk is tying SpaceX and Tesla closer together, amid speculation of an eventual merger. Both stocks fell Wednesday after SpaceX's earnings.

items.title: Musk Says These Tesla Products Will 'Dramatically' Increase Starlink Demand
items.summary: Tesla's AI products will "dramatically" increase demand for SpaceX's Starlink internet service, CEO Elon Musk said. Both stocks are down.

items.title: Elon Musk Predicts ‘Money Won’t Matter in 2036.’ Is This His Worst Prediction Yet or Prophetic?
items.summary: Elon Musk told a crowd at Tesla's Texas Gigafactory that currency itself will become pointless within a decade, and economists are lining up on both sides of whether that claim deserves serious analysis or a spot on his list of famously missed deadlines.

items.title: Elon Musk Thinks the SpaceX Crash is an ‘Insane Opportunity’—Should You Trust Him?
items.summary: SpaceX just posted its first public earnings report and shares cratered in after-hours trading, but Elon Musk is calling the selloff a buying opportunity. Before you follow his lead, there are some serious questions about the numbers worth considering.

items.title: Uber’s Ride-Sharing Business Is Booming. Why the Stock Market Couldn’t Care Less.
items.summary: The ride-hailing company reported mostly in-line second-quarter earnings and guidance that missed expectations.

items.title: Uber Aims to Build the World's Largest Autonomous Vehicle Platform. Can It Compete With Tesla?
items.summary: Uber is investing aggressively in robotaxis.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Is on the Rise, After Elon Musk Says SpaceX Will ‘Exclusively’ Buy Its Chips
items.summary: Nvidia shares are getting a lift after some encouraging comments from SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk.
